clue.text: Official encourages right to leave sanctuaries

parts.note: a ref is a referee, a match official

indicators.note: to leave says the letter for right is taken out of the word for encourages

parts.note: urges means encourages

explanation.surface: A sports official urges a player on the right to quit the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Places of shelter and safety are sanctuaries, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Salesperson has no starter, getting kind of square meal

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative

indicators.note: no starter says the first letter of the word has is dropped

parts.note: the word has, taken as written before trimming
a T-square is a drawing instrument, so T is a kind of square

explanation.surface: A beheaded salesman sits down to a square meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Square meal' looks like one phrase, but 'kind of square' gives T and 'meal' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A repast is a formal or literary word for a meal or feast.

clue.text: Religious types following theology as ruse, oddly

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
RI, religious instruction, the old school subject

indicators.note: oddly says take the first, third and fifth letters of the words as ruse

explanation.surface: Clergy who follow theology merely as a ruse, strangely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Theology' gives RI, religious instruction in British schools.
explanation.definitionFit: Friars are members of mendicant orders, so they are religious people.

clue.text: Suppose you will enter European resting place

indicators.note: will enter says the word for you goes inside the word for suppose

parts.note: to guess is to suppose
thou is the archaic form of you

explanation.surface: A guess that you will be let into Europe and find somewhere to rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A guesthouse is a small lodging where travellers stay and rest overnight.

clue.text: Destiny lies in quiet tree-dweller

indicators.note: lies in says the word for destiny sits inside the word for quiet

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
your lot in life is your destiny

explanation.surface: A philosophical line about fate lying in silence.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloths are slow mammals that live hanging in rainforest trees.

clue.text: One contributing to hive of activity?

definitions.text: One contributing to hive of activity?

parts.words: One contributing to hive of activity?
parts.note: literally a worker bee bustling in its hive; figuratively a person always occupied, part of a hive of activity

explanation.surface: A worker helping to make a bustling place hum.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes an industrious person, and literally a bee working in a hive.

clue.text: Chief and ace star in dance music

parts.note: a boss is a chief
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards
a nova is a star that suddenly brightens

explanation.surface: A chief and his top performer starring in a dance show.
explanation.definitionFit: Bossa nova is a Brazilian style of music and dance blending samba and jazz.

clue.text: Cliff's disc, artful in part

indicators.note: in part says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Cliff Richard's record is cleverly made, at least partly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cliff's' reads as Cliff is, the definition followed by a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A scar is a steep rocky cliff or crag, especially in northern England.

clue.text: Weighs tips of big aggressive weapons

indicators.note: tips of says take the first letter of each of the words big and aggressive

parts.note: lances are spear-like weapons

explanation.surface: Someone assessing the points of large, hostile arms.
explanation.definitionFit: To balance options is to weigh them against each other.

clue.text: Writer says it's nuts to support English

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits beneath, so the letter for English comes first and the rest stands on it
nuts means crazy, so the letters of says it's are scrambled

explanation.surface: A writer claims it's mad to back England.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer the piece being supported is on top, so 'to support English' puts the anagram of SAYSITS after E.
explanation.definitionFit: An essayist is a writer of essays.

clue.text: Parking before trip to see lion's group

parts.note: P is the map and sign abbreviation for parking
a ride is a trip or journey

explanation.surface: Park the car before taking a safari ride to see lions.
explanation.definitionFit: A pride is the collective noun for a group of lions.

clue.text: Occasionally on base, team cuss about the French blockages

indicators.note: about says the run of alternate letters goes round the French article
occasionally says take every other letter, starting with the first, of on base, team cuss

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: A baseball team occasionally swearing about French opponents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts the alternate letters OBSTACS round LE, between C and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Obstacles are things that block the way, which is what blockages do.

clue.text: Son and thief capturing Dickens character lacking charisma in jotter

indicators.note: capturing says the son-and-thief pair surrounds the trimmed character

parts.note: a pad, short for footpad, is an old word for a highway robber

indicators.note: lacking says the letters for charisma are removed from the character's name

parts.note: Bob Cratchit is Scrooge's clerk in A Christmas Carol
it is slang for sex appeal or charisma

explanation.surface: A boy and a robber make off with a dull Dickensian figure in a notebook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' meaning charisma, as in having 'it', comes off CRATCHIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A scratchpad is a notepad for rough working, essentially a jotter.

clue.text: Grudging discontent found in Nevada, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it says the abbreviation is spoken as letters, en-vee

parts.note: NV is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Nevada

explanation.surface: Resentful dissatisfaction discovered in the Nevada desert.
explanation.definitionFit: Envy is resentful longing for what someone else has, a grudging discontent; one of the deadly sins.

clue.text: Long distance flyers supply rats toucan's not caught

indicators.note: supply is the adverb of supple, so the letters bend into a new order
not says the letter for caught is left out of the fodder

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Birds — rats and toucans — that escape capture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supply' is the anagram signal (in a supple way); removing C from RATSTOUCANS leaves letters that rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronauts travel the longest distances of any flyers, into space.

clue.text: Chap to employ ship, acquiring new desire for other's property

parts.note: cove is old British slang for a chap

indicators.note: acquiring says the word for employ and the ship take in the letter for new

parts.note: to use is to employ
SS is steamship, a standard abbreviation

explanation.surface: A man sets out to hire a vessel, picking up something new.
explanation.definitionFit: Covetousness is greed for what belongs to others, one of the deadly sins.

clue.text: One up with the lark?

parts.note: a bird literally awake alongside the lark at dawn, figuratively a person who rises early

explanation.surface: Someone who rises at dawn when larks sing.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting up with the lark means rising at dawn, as an early riser does.

clue.text: Nearly fix backing of lavish city's overindulgence

indicators.note: nearly says the last letter of the word for fix is dropped

parts.note: glue is a fixative, to fix

indicators.note: backing of says the abbreviation for lavish is read backwards

parts.note: OTT, over the top, means lavish
NY is New York, the city

explanation.surface: Almost mending the extravagant finances of a city given to excess.
explanation.definitionFit: Gluttony is excessive eating and drinking, overindulgence; one of the deadly sins.

clue.text: Terrible twitch absorbing universal medicine

indicators.note: absorbing says the pair takes the letter for universal inside

parts.note: dire means terrible
U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal
a tic is a nervous twitch

explanation.surface: An awful spasm that a cure-all should treat.
explanation.definitionFit: A diuretic is a drug that increases urine output, so a type of medicine.

clue.text: Liar is free as lunatic to produce non-interference

indicators.note: lunatic means crazy, so the letters of liar is free as are jumbled

explanation.surface: A deranged liar claims freedom, refusing to let anyone meddle.
explanation.definitionFit: Laisser-faire is a policy of leaving things alone, the doctrine of not intervening.

clue.text: Requesting a second with Elvis, maybe

parts.note: Elvis Presley is called the King of rock and roll

explanation.surface: Asking Elvis for a moment of his time.
explanation.definitionFit: Requesting and asking are synonyms.

clue.text: Snake regularly meanest in trees

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake

indicators.note: regularly says take every second letter of meanest

explanation.surface: A particularly nasty snake lurks in the trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspens are poplars with trembling leaves, a kind of tree.

clue.text: Rent floor without walls

indicators.note: without walls says the outer letters of the word for floor are removed

parts.note: a storey is a floor of a building

explanation.surface: Paying rent for a floor that has no walls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rent' looks like a payment, but it is the past tense of tear.
explanation.definitionFit: Rent as a verb in the past means ripped, the same as torn apart.

clue.text: Bullies managed northern island after heartless Tory uncovered mess

indicators.note: after says the managed-northern-island run follows the trimmed Tory
heartless says the middle letters of Tory are removed, leaving its ends

parts.note: ran means managed

indicators.note: uncovered says the outer letters of mess are stripped away

explanation.surface: A cruel Tory politician running the north of an island after exposing a scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: To tyrannise is to rule cruelly, which is what a bully does to others.

clue.text: Temper risk — don't open it!

indicators.note: don't open it says the first letter of the word for risk is removed

parts.note: danger is risk

explanation.surface: A warning label on a dangerous box of bad temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Anger means a bad temper or rage; one of the deadly sins.

clue.text: Fat sultan held up suppressing desire

indicators.note: held up says the hidden letters are read backwards
suppressing says the words hold the letters down inside them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A fat sultan bottling up his cravings.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'suppressing' in the definition, but it is the hiding indicator; 'desire' alone defines. 'held up' reverses TSUL in a down light.
explanation.definitionFit: Lust is strong desire, especially sexual; one of the deadly sins.

clue.text: Imposing old boy hoping daughter replaces saint

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

indicators.note: replaces says the letter for daughter takes the place of the saint

parts.note: trusting means hoping

explanation.surface: A former pupil hopes his daughter will stand in for a holy figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Obtruding means pushing oneself forward unwelcome, imposing on others.

clue.text: Join group with European

parts.note: a unit is a group, as in an army unit

explanation.surface: Becoming part of a European group.
explanation.definitionFit: To unite is to bring together, to join.

clue.text: Cheat resolved to enter empty dinghy, returned and raced, perhaps

indicators.note: returned says the whole assembly is read backwards
to enter says the scrambled cheat goes inside the emptied dinghy
empty says only the outer letters of dinghy are kept
resolved here means broken down and re-formed, so the letters of cheat are reordered

explanation.surface: A cheat gets into an empty dinghy, goes back and races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolved' is the anagram signal, making ETHCA; 'returned' reverses DETHCAY. 'raced, perhaps' defines by example: racing is one way of sailing.
explanation.definitionFit: Racing in a yacht is one example of sailing a yacht, hence perhaps.

clue.text: Gives up concerning omens

parts.note: re means concerning or about
signs are omens

explanation.surface: Someone quits after reading the omens.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign is to give up a post, quitting it.
